v1.1.0.description:
## Additions
- Added YAML shuffle options for shrine chests, lightroots, and Dragon's Tears.
- Added a YAML option for randomizing the starting tower. If disabled (default), you start with the Lookout Landing Tower. If enabled, you start with one of six starter-friendly towers.
## Other Changes
- Updated instructions to include which flags correspond to which towers, in case a player would prefer to just enable and warp to them instead of using coordinates. Note that logic will still expect that you have what would be needed to climb them, if applicable.
## Known Issues
- If both shrine chest and lightroot shuffles are disabled at the same time, generation fails due to too few locations to place needed items.
